input.description: Test flatpak metadata command for RustDesk

state.output:
<stdout>
[Application]
name=com.rustdesk.RustDesk
runtime=org.freedesktop.Platform/x86_64/24.08
sdk=org.freedesktop.Sdk/x86_64/24.08
command=rustdesk

[Context]
shared=network;ipc;
sockets=x11;wayland;pulseaudio;fallback-x11;
devices=dri;
filesystems=home;

[Extension com.rustdesk.RustDesk.Locale]
directory=share/runtime/locale
autodelete=true
locale-subset=true

[Extension com.rustdesk.RustDesk.Debug]
directory=lib/debug
autodelete=true
no-autodownload=true

[Build]
built-extensions=com.rustdesk.RustDesk.Locale;com.rustdesk.RustDesk.Debug;
</stdout>
